info.title: v2.livestream.get_item_count
info.description: Get the number of items in the shopping bag, including the current number of items in the shopping bag, the upper limit of the number, etc. (For TW, ID, TH, PH, MY, SG, VN)

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/livestream/get_item_count?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&session_id=6236215&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
